description: Advance caller-ID contact histories with explicit active and missing tick counters.
output_invariants: ids are unique nonnegative safe integers. A reused deleted ID denotes the same logical identity while any old history can be supplied; callers wanting a new identity must use a new ID. Input pairs are strict lexicographic original indices i<j. A contact is {ids:[lowId,highId],activeTicks,missingTicks}; ID pairs and records are strict lexicographic, activeTicks is positive safe integer, missingTicks any nonnegative safe integer. Output is fresh, sorted by IDs, and no output array/record aliases input.

behavior.validation: Exact passive plain/null-prototype records and dense ordinary arrays with own data slots only; all scalar values finite where applicable. Validate ids, pairs, contacts, lingerSteps and maxWork in schema order before the work check. Contacts naming deleted IDs are valid stale state. Each array length<=4294967295; columns*rows must be a safe integer<=4294967295 with exact value-array correspondence. Full numeric validation before work; no aliases/mutation/partial output. Exposed zeros canonical positive. Proxies outside interchange.
behavior.work: Charge N+P+H after static validation, where N is ids length, P current pairs length, H prior contacts length. If it exceeds maxWork, throw WORK_LIMIT before output allocation. Current pairs are converted to ID pairs and sorted, so time is O(P log P+N+H), storage O(N+P+H).
behavior.order: Merge sorted current ID pairs and sorted prior contacts. A matching current pair returns activeTicks+1,missingTicks=0. A new pair returns 1,0. An absent prior pair drops without increment when either ID is deleted or missingTicks>=lingerSteps; otherwise returns its activeTicks and missingTicks+1. Counter addition beyond safe integer is NUMERIC_OVERFLOW.
behavior.environment: No radius query, positions, renderer, clock, RNG, opacity curve or retained host state. Caller supplies the graph and maps ticks to marks.
behavior.numerics: Ordered separate binary64 primitives; finite-check every computed primitive. fdlibm sin/cos/hypot existing audited implementations. Exact shared fixture outputs; independent trigonometric analytical oracles abs1e-12 relative0, indices/errors/counters exact. No epsilon in classification.
behavior.native_surface: contactHistory2D(input); p5-only initial target, named package export; errors carry stable code.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: carrier, canonicality, ID or counter domain failure
errors.NUMERIC_OVERFLOW: active tick increment exceeds portable safe integer
